@days = 5

shared_focus = {
	id = SHARED_root
	available = {
		threat > 0.5
	}
}

focus_tree = {
	id = sample_tree
	shared_focus = SHARED_root

	focus = {
		id = SAMPLE_a
		mutually_exclusive = { focus = SAMPLE_b }
		available_if_capitulated = yes
		available = {
			has_war = yes
		}
	}

	focus = {
		id = SAMPLE_b
		prerequisite = { focus = SAMPLE_a focus = SHARED_root }
		prerequisite = { focus = SAMPLE_c }
		bypass = {
			always = no
		}
		allow_branch = {
			has_dlc = "Test"
		}
		available = {
			date > @days
		}
	}

	focus = {
		id = SAMPLE_hidden
		allow_branch = { always = no }
	}

	focus = {
		id = SAMPLE_locked
		available = { always = no }
	}
}
